name: AdvancedSearchSrReappearanceWorker
input: one current ticket_import.sr_reappearance_reconcile DurableJobClaimV1 whose closed payload names one published advanced_search_sr import_run_id plus immutable LLD-04 source observations and declared LLD-03 source-presence owner interfaces
run_guard: validate the registered job type/version/payload/checkpoint before execution; payload source_family is exactly advanced_search_sr and checkpoint import_run_id, when present, equals payload import_run_id
the named ImportRun must remain a published non-noop advanced_search_sr run; its current revision may advance after publication but must never be lower than payload.published_run_revision
the worker never opens/parses a workbook and never accepts source field values
page_algorithm: read immutable source_observations for the exact import_run_id where source_family=advanced_search_sr, entity_kind=service_request, identity_state=valid, canonical_primary_id is nonnull and presence_state=observed_valid_identity
order raw technical rows by canonical_primary_id ASC, source_observation_id ASC; resume strictly after the checkpoint pair and read at most 500 rows per keyset page
processed_exact_count counts raw technical rows whose cursor was durably advanced, including conflict rows, equivalent duplicate suppressions and rows requiring no owner mutation

for each canonical SR represented in the page, classify the complete same-run valid row set by row_logical_sha256: more than one distinct hash is conflict and no row from that canonical SR can resolve a warning; one hash with duplicates makes the lexicographically smallest source_observation_id the sole representative and suppresses the remaining equivalent duplicates; one row is unique
classification queries may inspect rows outside the current page for that same canonical SR so a page boundary can never turn a conflicting or equivalent-duplicate group into false unique authority
owner_dispatch: for each unique or equivalent-duplicate representative, resolve the current LLD-03 Service Request by exact official SR number; absence means no reviewed warning can exist and the technical row may be checkpointed without a domain command
read current_source_presence for advanced_search_sr; if no active disappearance warning exists, checkpoint the technical row without opening a material owner command
if a warning is active, execute one replay-safe internal CommandBoundary command targeting that Service Request; committed replay is resolved before fresh claim/owner reads

fresh prepare first calls DurableJobCoordinator.assert_claim_current in the same owner-command UnitOfWork before receipt insertion, then re-resolves exact SR identity and current source-presence state; if the warning became inactive before receipt, return a bounded NO_CHANGE response and emit no audit

fresh material apply constructs SrSourceReappearanceMutation using the current active_disappearance_event_id, exact import_run_id, exact representative source_observation_id and the internal command_id, then calls LLD-03 apply_source_reappearance; only returned LLD-03 owner audit events are emitted by CommandBoundary
IMPORT_PROPOSAL_STALE from the material owner path is propagated as the registered retryable per-SR stale outcome and the durable checkpoint remains before that technical row

internal_command_identity.derivation: serialize the closed object {schema:'SOMA_SR_REAPPEARANCE_COMMAND_ID_V1',job_id,import_run_id,canonical_sr_no,source_observation_id} as strict canonical UTF-8 JSON; SHA-256 those bytes; take digest bytes 0..15; set byte 6=(byte 6 AND 0x0f) OR 0x40 and byte 8=(byte 8 AND 0x3f) OR 0x80; format those 16 bytes as lowercase canonical RFC4122 UUID text
internal_command_identity.rule: the mutable active_disappearance_event_id is deliberately excluded from command identity/request payload because committed replay after a crash must be reconstructible after that event is no longer active; fresh prepare alone reads and binds the current active event before receipt
internal_command_identity.collision_policy: normal CommandBoundary command receipt request-hash binding applies; any derived UUID collision with a different request fails IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT and never mutates owner state

checkpoint_and_completion: advance DurableJobCoordinator.checkpoint only after the corresponding technical row has been safely skipped or its internal command has committed/replayed; checkpoint uses that row's exact canonical SR/source_observation cursor and increments processed_exact_count by one

a failure before checkpoint leaves the cursor before that row; if the owner command already committed, retry derives the same command_id and exact replay prevents a second presence event before the checkpoint is retried
after a page is exhausted, continue from the durable cursor using another <=500-row page; when no rows remain, DurableJobCoordinator.complete revalidates the exact claim and records job completion

claim cancellation/recovery/replacement between any prior checkpoint and a fresh per-SR command causes JOB_CLAIM_CONFLICT before receipt/domain mutation; a stale worker cannot advance checkpoint or complete
failure_policy: malformed persisted job state, wrong run/source family, revision regression, invalid canonical SR/observation identity, conflicting source rows, owner identity ambiguity, evidence-provider rejection, stale claim or owner-state drift never fabricates reappearance authority; only conflict/equivalent-suppression/no-warning/no-SR cases are safe technical skips, while registered retryable failures retain the cursor before the affected row
